title: 総選挙
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: LEFT ①: black-haired green-eyed working Minto in black/neon-green devil cafe costume excitedly gives Hajime an election ballot, saying 「総選挙だよ♡」 RIGHT ②: huge ridiculous IDOL ELECTION STADIUM full of posters; EVERY candidate poster is the SAME Minto in different poses, all ballot boxes have her portrait, audience seats completely empty except Hajime. Minto on grand podium with trophy says 「接戦でした♡」 Hajime holding his lone ballot asks 「相手、誰？」 Same adult Minto, no real idol logos or political real-world reference.
